title: Whitespace to hyphen rule
prompt:
Return one JSON object and nothing else that describes a JavaScript string replacement. Use the keys pattern, replacement, and flags.

The replacement must turn runs of whitespace into a single hyphen and leave other characters alone. flags may be an empty string or g.

Examples the rule must satisfy: "Hello World" becomes "Hello-World", "a  b" becomes "a-b", and "a-b" stays "a-b". Do not call eval.
constraints: JSON with pattern, replacement, and flags
